subject: Temporary Delegation & Vendor Roster Scrub — DataBank change request
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@databank.co.uk>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@databank.co.uk
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Notice of temporary processing delegation + roster reconcile request

Hi Marissa,

Quick heads-up from our side — DataBank is moving a small subset of telemetry processing for EU region to a temporary analytics partner (EdgeCap) for a six-week performance test. We need to confirm whether EdgeCap is already listed as a subprocessor under Redwood's DPA, and if not, whether we can proceed under a provisional delegation while paperwork is processed.

Could you:
- Share a current subprocessor roster CSV and the expected time to add a short-lived partner to the DPA?
- Confirm any operational constraints (onshore routing, log retention limits) we should be aware of for the pilot?

We'd like to keep the pilot window 2028-07-25 to 2028-09-05. Procurement has asked for a minimal addendum template if needed.

Thanks — appreciate a quick turnaround.

Liam
Head of Infrastructure
DataBank Ltd.
[Attachment: pilot_scope_summary.docx (docx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@databank.co.uk>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice of temporary processing delegation + roster reconcile request

Hi Liam — thanks for the heads-up. We're able to support a short pilot but need to follow our subprocessor onboarding controls. High level:

1) I'll attach our current roster snapshot (roster_snapshot_20280719.csv) and a provisional addendum (subprocessor_addendum_v1.pdf) for review.
2) For a temporary partner we require:
   - a signed addendum to our DPA (accepts our standard security appendix)
   - evidence of SOC2 or equivalent (self-attestation acceptable for short pilots)
   - clearly limited data scope and retention policy (we can enforce via routing policy)

Naomi (Trust & Safety) — can you confirm if EdgeCap's public controls page is sufficient or if we need an attestation?
Jonas (Legal Ops) — procurement will likely want the addendum redlined; any expedited path for a six-week pilot?

Liam — please send EdgeCap's security contact and any attestation as soon as possible. We can queue the change but we won't propagate routing until the addendum is signed.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Risk Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: roster_snapshot_20280719.csv (csv)]

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice of temporary processing delegation + roster reconcile request

On Tue, Jul 20, 2028 at 10:03 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Naomi (Trust & Safety) — can you confirm if EdgeCap's public controls page is sufficient or if we need an attestation?

Quick skim of EdgeCap's controls page looks ok but missing evidence for encryption key management and transient log retention policies. For a short pilot we can accept:
- a signed attestation (template attached) confirming they will not persist raw telemetry beyond 72 hours
- confirmation they will process EU-region traffic only (we'll enforce by routing)

I'll prepare a brief checklist and a short attestation template we can ask them to sign. If they can produce SOC2 report excerpt within two weeks we can promote them to full roster status; until then mark as "provisional, restricted-scope."

Naomi
Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-20T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice of temporary processing delegation + roster reconcile request

Folks — looping in Legal Ops (Priyom) per Marissa's ask.

Actionable plan:
- Marissa: share the provisional addendum and roster (done).
- Priyom: can we use the fast-track addendum for a one-off 6-week pilot? If so, we'll push to procure and get signatures; otherwise procurement will require full review which may delay.
- Naomi: once we have the attestation, I'll approve provisional status and instruct infra to apply routing rules.

Priyom — please advise on required redlines and whether I should clear procurement to treat this as a limited-scope temporary subprocessor (procurement already pinged from DataBank).

Thanks,
Jonas
Legal Operations

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-22T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice of temporary processing delegation + roster reconcile request

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed the attached provisional addendum and the roster snapshot. Short answer: we can fast-track this under our existing delegation process with three controls to protect Redwood and DataBank: 

1) Sign the attached addendum (subprocessor_addendum_v1.pdf) without redlines — add a one-paragraph clause limiting processing window to the pilot dates and restricting persistence to 72 hours.
2) Require a completed attestation form from EdgeCap (SOC2 excerpt not mandatory for pilot but preferred within 14 days). Naomi's checklist is acceptable.
3) Implement an infra-side routing tag and retention enforcement; infra to keep logs for audit but not forward raw payloads beyond retention window.

If DataBank procurement agrees, issue the addendum to EdgeCap and request the attestation. Once both are in our possession, Naomi will flip their status to "provisional" and infra will deploy the routing rule for EU traffic only.

Marissa — I'll draft a short approval memo (legal sign-off) you can use to expedite procurement.

Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Legal Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: subprocessor_addendum_v1.pdf (pdf)]
